## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 9, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _QuizoidZ_, Jul 14, 2026, 1/5: "I love the layout, style, and customization. I prefer a “checklist” style which you can set by putting every goal at a 1/1, but it is interesting this kind of goal, things you do once a day, isn’t innate in the system. Also, the app keeps asking me to rate it… almost daily. Once is enough. 🤣 -1 ⭐️ This is a pretty cool app, but there’s some glitch where even after putting in my 5-star review it keeps asking for them. -1 ⭐️🤣🤣 -1 ⭐️ This is like every day 🤣🤣🤣 -1 ⭐️Now I’m down to one star. Maybe they’ll notice and turn off the constant review nagging. 🤣"
            2. _Rxxhxm_, Jun 9, 2026, 1/5: "I am a long term user. I have been using it everyday since January 2021. I have even bought the premium version of the app. This app has really helped me with my life. I highly recommend this app to anyone wanting a track their habits. However, I would not recommend this app to use long-term as if you want to track your progress, you can’t as I have explained below. I initially reviewed and rated it 5*. The reason why I am rating it 1* is because, as time went by, the habit tracking became more and more broken, unstable, unusable meaning that if you go on any specific habit, then you scroll down to ‘trending’ or ‘comparison’ between weeks, months and years. It doesn’t show last weeks or this weeks / last month or this month / last year or this years progress. Instead, it’s just a blank black screen. This has been like this for 6-9 months and I thought that I would give the developers the opportunities to fix this issue however they did not fix the issue but instead of pushing out new features and updates rather than fixing the original issue. This is unfair for the people who has paid for the premium service, but isn’t getting the basic features of the app."
            3. _Girly1224_, Aug 4, 2026, 5/5: "Same issue here app keeps crashing and I have the paid version would really like it if I am updated about this current issue. I actually really like the app but this issue needs to be updated. Ill come back and give it a better review once its fixed."
<!--/ir-theme-->
